subject.title: fix(codex): restore native PreToolUse relay delivery

question: Should OpenClaw accept this policy-active unified-exec and fresh-thread behavior before the bundled Codex runtime contains the Code Mode PreToolUse behavior required by openai/codex#23411?
rationale: The mechanical alias fix is clear, but the permanent security boundary depends on maintainer intent about a patched external runtime plus compatibility and session-state tradeoffs for existing Codex policy users.

options.title: Hold Until Runtime And Alias Are Proven
options.body: Keep the PR draft until `code_mode_exec` normalization lands and OpenClaw either pins/proves a Codex package with the needed hook behavior or documents the patched-runtime prerequisite explicitly.

options.title: Accept OpenClaw Side First
options.body: After the alias repair, maintainers may intentionally merge the OpenClaw relay fixes while owning the temporary patched Codex runtime prerequisite.

options.title: Prefer Fail-Closed Alternative
options.body: Pause this positive-delivery PR and route policy-active users through the fail-closed canary or broader native-surface mitigation work instead.

recommendation.title: Hold Until Runtime And Alias Are Proven
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft until `code_mode_exec` normalization lands and OpenClaw either pins/proves a Codex package with the needed hook behavior or documents the patched-runtime prerequisite explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: Root ownership plus the strongest Codex app-server history makes @steipete the best available decision owner for the security and compatibility boundary.
